signalId.description: Unique identifier of the matching real-world signal

summary.description: A comprehensive summary of the signal topic and its context

supportingEvidence.description: Factual evidence items supporting the proposal

contradictingEvidence.description: Evidence or factors that contradict or dissent from the proposal

confidence.description: The composite confidence score of the evaluation

riskFactors.description: Key risk factors or safety boundaries identified

reasoning.description: Detailed explanation of the cognitive reasoning behind the recommendation

recommendedDecision.description: The recommended protocol action based on the consensus evaluation
